Anna —

Thanks for the clear list. I attached a 1-page privacy summary that covers our default data handling for hosted inference and the options available for Dedicated and Private deployments. Short answers here: 

- Do we train on customer prompts? No, by default we do not train or fine-tune models on customer prompts or responses. We maintain an option for customers who explicitly opt in for benchmarking programs; that is gated and documented.
- Logs retained: request metadata + model I/O are retained by default for 30 days for troubleshooting and analytics; prompt text and responses are stored encrypted and can be configured to be ephemeral for Dedicated/Private.
- Opt-out controls: Dedicated and Private customers can enable a no-train and ephemeral I/O mode; Hosted customers can request an account-level opt-out which routes to a non-training storage policy.
- KMS/encryption: We support customer-managed keys for Dedicated and Private. Hosted offers server-side encryption with customer KMS for enterprise accounts.

I copied Marissa for procurement/timeline and Laura for legal/SIG coordination. Attached: redwood_privacy_one-pager.pdf.

Next steps: Marissa, can we offer to complete the SIG spreadsheet or schedule a short call? Anna, if you can share the SIG items you’re most concerned about we’ll prioritize.

Best,

Hi Julian / Anna — attaching the anonymized sample and a short policy snippet for SIG copy-paste. Summary of technical controls below: 

- Training on customer prompts: Redwood does not incorporate customer prompts/responses into model weights or training pipelines by default.
- Opt-in benchmarking: Customers can opt in for benchmarking programs; opt-in is recorded via contract amendment and engineering ticket. Opt-in data is segregated and used only for specified experiments; customers can opt out later.
- Storage/retention specifics: Hosted default retention = 30 days for full request/response payloads (encrypted). Logs (metadata, routing traces) retained 90 days. For Dedicated/Private you can configure ephemeral storage (minutes to days) or set a retention policy via console/API.
- Export sample: s3-retention-sample.csv attached (anonymized). Schema columns: timestamp, request_id, model_variant, prompt_length, token_count, retention_ttl_days (shows configured TTL).
- KMS & encryption: We support AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault for Dedicated & Private; BYOK supported for Dedicated/Private — keys can be customer-managed and rotated per company policy. Hosted enterprise accounts can integrate with customer KMS in specific regions (subject to contract).
- Evidence & audit support: We can produce scoped exports (redacted) and provide access logs. For SOC 2 or DPIA evidence we coordinate with legal; Laura is copied.

Attachments: no-train-ops-flow.png (PNG), s3-retention-sample.csv (CSV)

Policy snippet for SIG (copy):
"Redwood Inference does not use customer-provided prompt or response text to train or improve production models unless the customer has explicitly and contractually opted in to a defined benchmarking or research program. Retention and processing controls are configurable and documented in customer-specific data processing addenda."
